description: Set start/end time on up to 20 campaigns or ad squads. Changes that let ACTIVE items deliver sooner are checked and limited like enabling them. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_bulk_set_schedule
